description: The case's committed/ config sets build_max_rework_rounds to 0. build-phase implements T-1.2 and T-1.3, verify-spec finds the fixture's planted FR-001 gap, and with no rework round allowed the run stops with the round-limit reason: no task is reopened and T-1.1 is not reworked.

must_match.why: gaps are left at the round limit
T-1.2 and T-1.3 were implemented and nothing was reworked
the one report's tally: FR-001 is the gap, FR-004 is blocked

must_match.pattern: ^Stopped: FR-001 still not met after 0 rework rounds$
must_match.why: the round-limit reason from build-rules.md, with the limit from the config
the verify report went through parse_reply.py

must_not_match.why: a stopped run has no hand-off line
T-1.1 is not reworked past the limit
it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: git log on reading-time/phase-1: the T-1.2 and T-1.3 commits and nothing after them.
tasks.md: T-1.1 is still Done and T-1.4 still Todo.
The limit is 0, so this proves the stop and that nothing is reopened past the limit. It does not prove a run that used its rounds and still had gaps.
